pf_weighted_hint: Mean lease score weighted by monthly rent.
pf_ending_peak: Most leases ending in one month

pf_rules_hint: They override the defaults for new leases in that municipality or group. A group wins over a municipality. Existing leases keep their terms.

billing_promotions_none: This listing has not been promoted yet.

lease_notice_landlord_intro: A landlord may end the lease only for a statutory reason (§ 2288 of the Civil Code). The notice period is at least 3 months.
lease_notice_landlord_written: The notice must be in writing, delivered to the tenant and must inform them of the right to object and to ask a court to review whether the notice is justified (§ 2286 and § 2290 of the Civil Code). The platform only records the notice and its delivery date; deliver the written notice to the tenant yourself.
lease_notice_reason_gross_breach_tenant: The tenant grossly breaches their duties (§ 2288(1)(a))
lease_notice_reason_conviction: The tenant was convicted of an intentional crime against the landlord, a household member, a resident of the house or property in the house (§ 2288(1)(b))
lease_notice_reason_public_interest_vaca: The flat must be vacated because the flat or house is to be dealt with in the public interest so that it cannot be used (§ 2288(1)(c))
lease_notice_reason_other_serious_reason: Another similarly serious reason – describe it below (§ 2288(1)(d))
lease_notice_reason_flat_needed_for_land: The flat is to be used by the landlord, their spouse or a close relative – indefinite-term leases only (§ 2288(2))
lease_notice_explanation_hint: Required for "another similarly serious reason"; recommended otherwise.
lease_notice_delivered_hint: The day the tenant received the written notice (at most 30 days ago, at most 7 days ahead).
lease_notice_landlord_confirm: I confirm the notice was (or will be) delivered to the tenant in writing and informs them of the right to object and ask a court to review it.
lease_notice_landlord_confirm_required: Confirm that the notice is in writing and informs the tenant of the right to a court review.
lease_notice_explanation_required: For another similarly serious reason, describe the facts behind the notice.
lease_notice_delivered_required: Fill in the date the notice was delivered.
own_slot_delete_confirm_booked: Delete this slot? Its bookings are cancelled and every booked applicant gets an e-mail and a notification (bookings: {count}).
own_slot_delete_hint: Deleting cancels the bookings and notifies the applicants.

bo_privacy_status_pending: the owner has not decided yet
bo_privacy_status_rejected: the owner kept the photo unblurred
err_notice_reason_not_applicable: This reason applies only to leases for an indefinite term.
err_income_proof_not_found: The income proof is no longer available (the application is closed or the file was deleted).
err_application_not_found: The application does not exist or you have no access to it.
lease_import_intro: Already renting the flat on a paper contract? Bring it here: nothing is signed again and the tenants hear nothing from us until you invite them.
lease_import_address_hint: Start typing the street and number and pick the address from the list (RÚIAN); the flat then joins your portfolio.
lease_import_notice_hint: Empty = the portfolio rules, else 3 months.
lease_import_vs_hint: Optional: the symbol the tenants already use in their standing order. Without it, the lease code is used.
lease_import_cutover_hint: The platform tracks payments from this day. Enter what the tenants owed before it as the opening balance; earlier months never count as debt.
lease_import_parties_hint: The e-mail is optional: tenants get no messages until you invite them to the tenant portal.
lease_import_opening_hint: The opening balance is what the tenant owes on the day payment tracking starts (0 = nothing).
lease_imported_hint: The contract was signed outside the platform.
lease_scan_none: The scan of the paper contract is missing.
lease_scan_hint: PDF, JPEG or PNG up to 20 MB.
lease_scan_missing: Choose the file with the contract scan.
lease_invite_intro: Tenants of an imported contract get no e-mails or notifications from us until you invite them. Once they sign in with the invited address they see payments, QR codes and the contract.
err_cutover_before_start: Payments cannot be tracked before the lease starts.
err_cutover_too_old: Payment tracking may start at most 31 days back; enter older debt as the opening balance.
err_cutover_too_far: Payment tracking may start at most 12 months ahead.
err_cutover_after_end: Payment tracking must start before the lease ends.
err_invalid_variable_symbol: A variable symbol has 1 to 10 digits.
err_variable_symbol_taken: Another of your leases already uses this variable symbol.
err_invalid_opening_balance: The opening balance must be zero or a positive amount.
err_opening_balance_guarantor: An opening balance belongs to a tenant, not a guarantor.
err_lease_not_imported: This is only for imported contracts.
err_party_linked: The tenant already uses the tenant portal.
err_party_not_found: This tenant is not a party of the lease.
err_upload_not_found: We could not find the uploaded file; please upload it again.
err_attachment_missing: The file was not uploaded; please try again.
